intro_zh: “处理完这件事就下线。”然后还有一个城、一个科技、下一回合的战斗。文明最难结束的往往不是战争，而是今天的游戏时间。「不再来一回合」给单人游戏加上几个明确的停顿点，让休息不再完全依赖临时的自觉。
intro_en: One more city to manage, one more technology to finish, one more battle next turn. I made No More Turn to give a single-player session clear stopping points, with breaks based on turns, elapsed time and the hours you choose.
limits_zh: 本文以已发布的 1.8.5 功能为范围。默认参数可以调整，休息限制作用于游戏内，不是系统级锁定。旧版实机图仅作界面参考；新版夜间、存档保留、设置保存及全部手柄流程仍需逐项补齐实机证据。休息存档须看到成功提示后再放心退出。
limits_en: This article covers the published 1.8.5 feature set. Defaults are configurable, and these are in-game restrictions rather than an operating-system lock. Historical screenshots are visual references only; current night rules, save retention, settings persistence and the full controller flow still need complete in-game evidence. Check that a rest save actually succeeded before relying on it.

sections.zh: 按回合休息，后期少一点“再来一次”
sections.pain_zh: 前期五回合很快，后期一回合却可能安排半个帝国。固定“再玩五回合”，到了后期就很容易变成很久。
sections.fix_zh: 默认休息间隔随当前回合阶段从五回合逐步缩短到一回合，也能自行调整。达到间隔后，在回合边界停下来休息；完成休息后，回合和时间两种计数一起重新开始。
sections.pain_en: Five early turns can be quick. Five late-game turns can take most of an evening.
sections.fix_en: The default interval gets shorter as the campaign advances, from five turns to one, and can be adjusted. A break at the turn boundary gives you a clear pause; finishing it resets both the turn and time counters.
sections.shot: 当前版达到回合间隔的休息面板，显示原因、剩余时间、退出入口。
sections.caption_zh: 历史 1.3 系列实机图：达到回合间隔后的休息倒计时。当前版界面已有变化。
sections.caption_en: Historical 1.3-series screenshot of a turn-triggered break. The current interface has changed.

sections.zh: 一回合还没结束，也别一直坐着
sections.en: Breaks even during a long turn
sections.pain_zh: 只按回合提醒，遇到大战、城市规划或反复比较建造选项时，就可能一直等不到休息。
sections.fix_zh: 连续游戏时间也单独计时，默认玩 25 分钟、休息 5 分钟。时间和回合规则可以一起使用；完成一次足额休息就同时重置两种累计，避免刚休息完又立刻被另一条规则拦住。
sections.pain_en: A turn-based reminder cannot help much when a single turn is taking a long time.
sections.fix_en: An independent timer defaults to 25 minutes of play followed by a five-minute break. Completing a full break resets both timers, so the other rule does not immediately demand another break.
sections.shot: 当前时间触发休息面板，原因明确为游戏时间到；避免沿用旧图中的测试时长。

sections.zh: 已经离开电脑，就把这次休息算上
sections.pain_zh: 已经起身喝水，再回来却又被要求从头休息，提醒就会变得不近人情。
sections.fix_zh: 默认闲置一分钟会进入主动休息计时。可以随时继续游戏；休息满要求时长后，两种累计都会重置。提前回来则保留之前的游戏累计，不会因为动一下鼠标就伪造完成了一次休息。
sections.pain_en: If you already stepped away for water, starting another mandatory break immediately afterward feels pointless.
sections.fix_en: Idle time starts a voluntary break after one minute by default. You can resume whenever you like. A full break clears both accumulated counters; an early return keeps the previous play totals.
sections.shot: 当前版主动休息面板，已休时长和可继续按钮同屏；不能用旧版仅 HUD 计时冒充当前面板。

sections.zh: 到点收工，不和下一回合讨价还价
sections.pain_zh: 最容易拖延的不是忘了时间，而是知道已经很晚，仍想把眼前这一步做完。
sections.fix_zh: 夜间限制默认覆盖 22:00 到次日 07:00，可独立开关和调整时段。限制期间保留退出入口，但不开放继续游戏；若要修改安排，可以回到主菜单设置。
sections.pain_en: Sometimes you know exactly how late it is and still want to finish the next thing.
sections.fix_en: A separate night rule defaults to 10 p.m.–7 a.m. and has configurable hours. During that period you can exit, but continuing the session is unavailable. The schedule can be adjusted from the main menu.
sections.shot: 测试设置触发夜间限制，显示当前时段与退出按钮；拍完必须恢复原时段。

sections.zh: 休息前留一份独立存档
sections.en: Keep a separate save when a break starts
sections.pain_zh: 愿意停下来，却担心刚才的进度没有落盘；或者休息越多，存档列表越长。
sections.fix_zh: 主动、时间、回合和夜间休息会创建带时间信息的 RestGuard 存档，并显示保存状态。默认保留最近十份，可调整数量；清理只针对模组自己的旧存档，且在新存档成功后进行，不会拿普通自动存档来凑数。
sections.pain_en: Stopping is easier when you have a checkpoint, but a new break save every time should not leave an endless list.
sections.fix_en: Idle, timed, turn-based and night breaks create distinct RestGuard saves and report their status. The default retention is ten. Cleanup only targets the mod’s own older saves after a new one succeeds, rather than deleting ordinary autosaves.
sections.shot: 当前休息面板显示存档已保存，并拍对应存档条目供核验；正文只放最清晰的一张。

sections.zh: 离下次休息还有多久，一眼看清
sections.pain_zh: 提醒完全不露面时容易忘记，做成巨大面板又会一直挡住游戏。
sections.fix_zh: 地图 HUD 用紧凑的时间和回合提示显示进度，也提供设置入口。间隔、休息时长和夜间时段集中在原生选项中，让提醒按自己的节奏工作。
sections.pain_en: An invisible timer is easy to forget; a permanent large panel gets in the way.
sections.fix_en: A compact HUD shows time and turn progress and provides access to settings. Intervals, break lengths and night hours live in the native options.
sections.shot: 当前版地图 HUD，读得清时间与回合剩余；旧图仅参考位置。
